title: Stereo, lookahead, and anomaly tests
description:
Add focused Catch2 (or existing project harness) unit tests covering LookaheadDelay latency/delay integrity, StereoLinker modes and λ blend, AnomalyGuard spike/stuck/dropout, and RejectedSignalRouter r[n]=x−y.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/TestMain.cpp and existing tests/* patterns from prior phases
- Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.*, StereoLinker.*, AnomalyGuard.*, RejectedSignalRouter.* public APIs
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §17–19 and §20.5 formulas
- CMakeLists.txt test registration from g.4 (do not re-own CMake — prefer zero CMake edits)

Implement tests/LookaheadTests.cpp:
1) Default Off: getLatencySamples()==0; process is pass-through within float epsilon on an impulse or sine.
2) Each discrete legal ms at fs=48000: latency samples == round(ms*0.001*fs); delayed impulse peaks at the expected index (±1 sample).
3) Illegal midpoint snaps or clamps to a legal setting (document expected behavior from implementation).
4) Finite output / no NaNs when changing lookahead mid-stream over a short block span.

Implement tests/StereoTests.cpp:
1) Max/Energy/Average formulas on known E_L/E_R pairs (exact or tight float tolerance).
2) λ blend: λ=0 keeps independent gains; λ=1 forces G_linked on both; λ=0.5 midpoint.
3) DualMono does not force shared envelope.
4) Mono safety: synthetic prolonged |G_L−G_R| divergence eventually sets warning.
5) AnomalyGuard: synthetic short extreme impulse with low body → spike suppress; long key-high + main-silent → stuck-key warning; drop key-valid → dropout/fallback after hold.
6) RejectedSignalRouter: with x=1, y=0.25 constant blocks, all-rejected audition ≈ 0.75; state filter mutes when state does not match.

Keep tests deterministic (fixed SR 48000, fixed lengths, explicit tolerances). No audio hardware. Only write the two test files registered by g.4.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
